αἰνήσουσιν: αἰνέω — praise, approve; fut. 3 pl.: ’they will approve’
βόλεσθε: βούλομαι — wish, want, prefer; pres. 2 pl., epic βόλεσθε (= Attic βούλεσθε)
γήμαιθ: γαμέω — marry (of a woman, mid. γαμέομαι); aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., elided (γήμαιθ’ = γήμαιτο), potential with κε: ’she might marry’
γερόντων: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. pl.
γνώσεαι: γιγνώσκω — come to know, perceive; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic γνώσῃ)
δείσασ: δείδω — fear, be afraid; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (δείσασ’ = δείσασα): ’having feared’
δεδάασθαι: δάω — learn, find out; perf. inf. mid. with aor. sense, epic: ’to learn about’
εἰλήλουθε: ἔρχομαι — come, go; perf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθε): ’has come’
εἴβοι: εἴβω — let fall in drops, shed; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after a past verb: ’she might shed’
εἴρηθ: εἴρω (ἐρῶ) — say, tell; plpf. pass. 3 sg. (εἴρηθ’ read as εἴρητο, the printed θ not explained by elision alone): ’had been said’
εἴσῃ: εἶμι — go; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic (= εἴσεαι): ’you will go (about)’
εὐεργής: εὐεργής — well-made, well-wrought; fem. nom. sg. (2-ending adj.), agreeing with νηῦς
θυμηδέ: θυμηδής — heart-pleasing, delightful; neut. acc. pl., elided (θυμηδέ’ = θυμηδέα), agreeing with χρήματα or used adverbially: ’to the heart’s pleasing’
κέρδος: κέρδος — gain, profit, advantage; neut. nom. sg.
κατήγετο: κατάγομαι — put in to land, come to shore; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was putting in’
κατήφησάν: κατηφέω — be downcast, be dejected; aor. 3 pl. (accented κατήφησάν before the enclitic τ’)
καταδύντι: καταδύω — sink, set (of the sun); intrans. aor. part., masc. dat. sg., temporal: ’as it sank’
κείνοις: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκείνοις); masc. dat. pl.: ’to those’
κιχῆναι: κιχάνω — overtake, reach; aor. inf., epic root aorist (ἐκίχην): ’to overtake’
κλυτίοιο: Κλύτιος — Clytius, a man whose house is named; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μέγαρόν: μέγαρον — hall; neut. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
μέσῃσι: μέσος — middle, in the midst; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), with μετά: ’in the midst of’
μεθησέμεναί: μεθίημι — let go, give up; fut. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic μεθήσειν), accented before the enclitic μιν
μετερχόμενος: μετέρχομαι — go after, go among, pursue; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’going after’
μετεφώνεεν: μεταφωνέω — speak among, address a company; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted -εεν (= Attic μετεφώνει)
μνάσθω: μνάομαι — woo, court; pres. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him woo’
μόρσιμος: μόρσιμος — destined, fated; adj., masc. nom. sg.: ’the destined (suitor)’
νηλείτιδές: νηλείτις — guiltless, blameless; fem. nom. pl. (accented νηλείτιδές before the enclitic εἰσιν)
παρερχομένην: παρέρχομαι — go past, pass by; pres. part. mid. fem. acc. sg., agreeing with νῆα
πατρώϊα: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, paternal; neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic πατρῷα): ’what is one’s father’s’
πειράζειν: πειράζω — try, test; pres. inf., by-form of πειράω (Attic πειρᾶν), + gen. or acc. of the person tried
πλείοντες: πλέω — sail; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic πλείω (= Attic πλέοντες)
πυλόθεν: Πύλος — Pylos, Nestor’s city; place-name with suffix -θεν: ’from Pylos’
σκοποὶ: σκοπός — lookout, watcher; masc. nom. pl.
στέλλοντας: στέλλω — furl, take in (sails); pres. part. masc. acc. pl.
σταθμοὺς: σταθμός — farmstead, steading; masc. acc. pl.
συναντήτην: συναντάω — meet (+ dat.); impf. 3 dual, epic (= Attic συνηντάτην): ’the two met’
φθέωμεν: φθάνω — be beforehand, forestall; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic φθέωμεν (= Attic φθῶμεν), hortatory: ’let us forestall (him)’
φθίσωμεν: φθίω — destroy, kill; aor. subj. 1 pl., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’that we may destroy’
χαλιφροσύναι: χαλιφροσύνη — slackness of mind, thoughtless laxity; fem. nom. pl.
χώρης: χώρη — place, spot (Ionic; Attic χώρα); fem. gen. sg.
ἀγγείλωσι: ἀγγέλλω — announce, report; aor. subj. 3 pl. (ν-movable), with κε in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to announce’
ἀγείρομεν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; pres. subj. 1 pl., short-vowel hortatory (= Attic ἀγείρωμεν): ’let us gather’
ἀθρόοι: ἀθρόος — crowded together, all together; masc. nom. pl.
ἀκάχοντο: ἀκαχίζω — distress, grieve; redup. aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, epic: ’were grieved’
ἀμφίνομος: Ἀμφίνομος — Amphinomus, one of the suitors; masc. nom. sg.
ἀναστὰς: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; intrans. aor. part. masc. nom. sg., root aorist: ’standing up’
ἀνύσσεσθαι: ἀνύω — accomplish, bring about; fut. inf. mid., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἀνύσεσθαι)
ἀπέειπε: ἀπεῖπον — say out, deliver (a message), tell out; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπεῖπε)
ἀπένεικαν: ἀποφέρω — carry off, bear away; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἀπήνεγκαν): ’they carried off’
ἀπήγαγεν: ἀπάγω — lead away, carry off; aor. 3 sg.
ἀπομηνίσει: ἀπομηνίω — rage, be wrathful (against); fut. 3 sg.: ’he will rage’
ἀποπλείειν: ἀποπλέω — sail away, sail off; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀποπλεῖν)
ἀφανδάνει: ἀφανδάνω — be displeasing, displease; pres. 3 sg. + dat., epic (ἀπο- + ἁνδάνω)
ἀφικώμεθα: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, come to; aor. subj. 1 pl. mid., in a fear clause after μή: ’and we come to’
ἁλιῆας: ἁλιεύς — seaman, sailor (lit. one of the sea); masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -έας)
ἄγετε: ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 pl., in the interjection ἄγε/ἄγετε: ’come now!’
ἄσαμεν: ἄω — spend the night, sleep; aor. 1 pl., epic (= ἀέσαμεν, contracted): ’we passed (the night)’
ἐέδνοισιν: ἕεδνον — bridal gift; neut. dat. pl. ἕεδνα, epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), instrumental: ’with bridal gifts’
ἐκίχημεν: κιχάνω — overtake, reach; aor. 1 pl., epic root aorist (ἐκίχην): ’we overtook’
ἐκγελάσας: ἐκγελάω — laugh out, laugh aloud; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἐμίμνομεν: μίμνω — stay, wait for; impf. 1 pl., epic reduplicated present (= Attic μένω, ἐμένομεν)
ἐξελάσωσι: ἐξελαύνω — drive out; aor. subj. 3 pl. (ν-movable), in a fear clause after μή, + acc.: ’and drive us out’
ἐπασσύτεροι: ἐπασσύτερος — close one upon another, in quick succession; masc. nom. pl.
ἐπιστήμων: ἐπιστήμων — skilled, knowing, expert (+ dat. of respect); masc. nom. sg.
ἐράπτομεν: ῥάπτω — stitch together, devise (of plots); impf. 1 pl., augmented with ρ not doubled, epic (= Attic ἐρράπτομεν): ’we were stitching’
ἐρέοντε: ἐρέω — will say, tell; fut. part. act., masc. nom. dual, epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐροῦντε), of purpose: ’to tell’
ἐφημοσύνην: ἐφημοσύνη — behest, charge, message entrusted; fem. acc. sg.
ἔδωμεν: ἔδω — eat, devour; pres. subj. 1 pl., epic (= Attic ἐσθίω), prohibitive after μή: ’let us not devour’
ἔχοντας: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’holding’
ἕρκεά: ἕρκος — enclosure, fence, pen; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic ἕρκη), accented before the enclitic τε
ἧμας: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — we; acc. pl., epic ἧμας (= Attic ἡμᾶς): ’us’
ἰφθίμη: ἴφθιμος — stout, mighty; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with βασίλεια
ἷζον: ἵζω — sit, sit down; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’were sitting’
ὁδῷ: ὁδός — road, way; fem. dat. sg.
ὁμηγυρίσασθαι: ὁμηγυρίζω — call to assembly (mid. convene, gather); aor. inf. mid.: ’to gather’
ὅστις: ὅστις, ἥτις, ὅ τι — whoever; indefinite relative pron., masc. nom. sg., with opt.: ’whoever might’
ὕστερα: ὕστερος — later, last; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’afterwards’
ῥέξωσι: ῥέζω — do, perform, bring about; aor. subj. 3 pl. (ν-movable), epic (= Attic δράω/ποιέω), in a fear clause after μή

__broaden__.αὐτόν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’himself’, or reinforcing a pronoun of any person (με … καὶ αὐτόν ’me myself as well’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’ as direct object of a verb: ἤλασε δ’ αὐτόν ’struck him’ · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, as subject of an infinitive: αὐτόν τε ζώειν ’that he live’
__broaden__.αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a ship, fem.), governed by a noun: χρεὼ ... αὐτῆς ’a need of it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a raft, fem.), governed by a preposition: ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ’upon it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, possessive with a noun: νόος ... αὐτῆς ’her mind’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, governed by a preposition, of a monster: ἀπ’ αὐτῆς ’away from her’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of the olive), governed by ἀγχόθι ’near’: ἀγχόθι δ’ αὐτῆς ’and near it’ · also intensive with a noun, fem. gen. sg.: αὐτῆς Ἰθάκης ’Ithaca itself’ · also ὁ αὐτός ’the same’, fem. gen. sg. with the article: τῆς αὐτῆς ἀγγελίης ’the same news’
__broaden__.αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. (ὣς δ’ αὔτως ’and in just the same way’) · also ’simply, without more’, of words alone (ἦ αὔτως ἐπέεσσιν ’or simply with words’) · also ’simply, idly, without more ado’, of sitting (αὔτως ἧσται ’sits idle’) · also ’without more, empty-handed’, of sending away with no gift (αὔτως ἀππέμψει ’will send us off with nothing’) · also ’to no purpose, idly’, of testing: αὔτως … πειρητίζων ’testing (each man) to no purpose’
__broaden__.δοῖμεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 1 pl., potential with κε: ’we would give’ · also without κε, in an exhortation: ’(let us) give’ (οἰκία … δοῖμεν ἔχειν ’let us give the house to keep’)
__broaden__.εἴσιδον: εἰσοράω — look at, catch sight of; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= εἰσεῖδον): ’I saw’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they saw’ (ἢ εἴσιδον αὐτοί ’or they saw for themselves’)
__broaden__.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’)
__broaden__.οὕνεκά: οὕνεκα — because, for the reason that (= οὗ ἕνεκα, contracted); conj. · also ’that’, introducing what a speaker will say (= ὅτι): ἐρέει … οὕνεκά ’he will say that’
__broaden__.οὕνεκα: οὕνεκα (crasis of οὗ ἕνεκα) — because; also relative: for the sake of which, for which reason; conj. · also ’that’, introducing what a messenger is to tell (= ὅτι): ἐρέοντα … οὕνεκα ’to tell that’
__broaden__.πάνθ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom. pl., elided and aspirated (πάνθ’ = πάντα): ’everything’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of a verb: ’all that’ (πάνθ’ ὅσα … μυθήσασθαι ’all that … to tell’)
__broaden__.πᾶν: πᾶς — all, whole; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with πεδίον: ’the whole (plain)’ · also neut. nom. sg. as a plain substantive: ’all, everything’ (οὔ πω πᾶν εἴρηθ’ ’not yet had everything been said’)
__broaden__.στρεφθεὶς: στρέφω — turn, twist; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having twisted, curled round’ · also ’having turned (round)’, of a man turning: στρεφθεὶς ἐκ χώρης ’turning round from his place’
__broaden__.τέρεν: τέρην — tender, delicate; neut. acc. pl., elided (τέρεν’ = τέρενα) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δάκρυον: ’tender (tear)’ (τέρεν, the neuter of τέρην)
__broaden__.τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also relative: ’who’ · also encl. dat. sg. pron. σύ ’to you’ (= τοι, accented before a following enclitic, e.g. τοί τι) · also τοι, the affirming particle, accented τοί before an enclitic: ἀλλ’ ἦ τοί σε ’but truly you’
__broaden__.τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ (τῆς ἕτερον μὲν θειλόπεδον ’of which one part is a drying-ground’) · also with a name, article-like: ’that’ (τῆς Σκύλλης ’of that Scylla’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the, that’ (τῆς ληΐδος ’that booty’) · also article with αὐτῆς, ’the same’: τῆς αὐτῆς ἀγγελίης ’the same news’
__broaden__.ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + acc. · also + dat., with anastrophe (χερσὶ ἐφ’ ὕδωρ): ’over, upon (the hands)’ · also + dat. without anastrophe, ’over’ (ἐφ’ αἵματι φάσγανον ἴσχων ’holding the sword over the blood’) · also + acc., ’to, towards’, of destination (ἐφ’ ἡμέτερ’ ’to our (home)’) · also + dat., of the person favoured: ’toward’ (ἐφ’ ἡμῖν ἦρα φέρουσιν ’show favour toward us’) · also + acc., ’for, among’, of a share: κατὰ μοῖραν ἐφ’ ἡμέας ’according to what is fitting, among us’
__broaden__.ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may... come’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if ... should come’ (εἰ καί ποθεν ἄλλοθεν ἔλθοι) · also in an indirect question after a past verb: ’from where she came’ (πόθεν ἔλθοι) · also in a relative clause with κε, prospective: ’(whoever) should come’ (ὅς κε … ἔλθοι)
__broaden__.ἔχωμεν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. subj. 1 pl., long vowel, in a relative clause with κε: ’whatever we have’ · also hortatory, in a main clause: ’let us keep’ (βίοτον … ἔχωμεν ’let us keep his livelihood’)
__broaden__.ὀτρύνομεν: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse, send speeding; aor. subj. 1 pl., short-vowel hortatory (= Attic ὀτρύνωμεν) · also after μή, prohibitive: ’let us not urge on’
__broaden__.ὑπεκφύγοι: ὑπεκφεύγω — escape from; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., potential with κέν: ’might escape’ · also optative of wish after μηδ’: ’may he not escape’
